Nginx 未运行，所有站点都无法访问（502/无法连接）: Nginx is not running; all sites are unreachable (502 / connection refused)
启动 Nginx（服务编排 → 启动全部，或 nginx start）: Start Nginx (Services -> Start all, or `nginx start`)
主配置已 include 站点目录，所有 vhost 会被读取: Main config includes the site directory; all vhosts are loaded
主配置未 include 站点目录（{dir}），站点配置不会生效: Main config does not include the site directory ({dir}); site config will not take effect
一键补 include（在 http 块内加入站点目录）: Auto-add the include (insert the site directory inside the http block)
站点配置已被禁用（.conf.disabled），Nginx 不会加载它: Site config is disabled (.conf.disabled); Nginx will not load it
无域名（仅 listen 端口的 server 块）: No domain (a server block with only a listen port)
全部域名已在 hosts 指向本机：{doms}: All domains point to localhost in hosts: {doms}
以下域名未指向本机（hosts 中缺失或非回环）：{doms}: The following domains do not point to localhost (missing from hosts or not loopback): {doms}
把缺失域名写入 hosts 指向 127.0.0.1: Write the missing domains into hosts pointing to 127.0.0.1
该 server 块没有 fastcgi_pass（静态站点 / 反代），不涉及: This server block has no fastcgi_pass (static site / reverse proxy); no PHP involved, PHP diagnosis not needed
端口 {port} 未映射到任何 PHP 版本。当前映射：{mapping}: Port {port} is not mapped to any PHP version. Current mapping: {mapping}
为该站点指定 PHP 版本（站点 → 切换 PHP 版本）: Assign a PHP version to this site (Site -> Switch PHP version)
无 PHP 版本关联，跳过运行检查: No PHP version associated; skipping running check
未检测到 PHP 版本 {ver}（可能未安装或未扫描到）: PHP version {ver} not detected (may not be installed or not scanned)
安装该 PHP 版本或改用已安装版本: Install that PHP version or switch to an installed one
PHP {ver} 未运行（端口 {port} 无监听），访问该站点会 502: PHP {ver} is not running (no listener on port {port}); the site will return 502
未配置 root（站点无文档根）: No root configured (site has no document root)
检查站点配置中的 root 指令: Check the root directive in the site config
修正站点 root 路径或部署项目文件: Fix the site root path or deploy the project files
根目录下未找到入口文件（index.php / public/index.php: No entry file found under the root (index.php / public/index.php, etc.): {root}
确认项目已部署到该目录: Make sure the project is deployed to this directory
根目录存在且含入口文件：{root}: Root exists and contains an entry file: {root}
非 HTTPS 站点，跳过证书检查: Not an HTTPS site; skipping certificate check
无法读取配置文件以确认证书路径: Cannot read the config file to confirm the certificate path
未找到 ssl_certificate 指令（证书可能由上层配置提供）: No ssl_certificate directive found (certificate may be provided by an upper-level config)
证书文件不存在：{p}（访问 HTTPS 会报 SSL 错误）: Certificate file does not exist: {p} (HTTPS access will report an SSL error)
重新生成 / 配置证书（站点 → 启用 HTTPS）: Regenerate / configure the certificate (Site -> Enable HTTPS)
最近 {n} 行错误日志中未发现与该域名相关的 5xx: No 5xx related to this domain found in the last {n} lines of the error log
错误日志中发现 {count} 条与该域名相关的 5xx：\n{sample}:
Found {count} 5xx entries related to this domain in the error log:
{sample}
打开 Nginx 日志查看完整错误上下文: Open the Nginx log to view the full error context
未找到 PHP 版本 {ver}，无法启动: PHP version {ver} not found; cannot start
暂不支持自动修复该项: Automatic fix not supported for this item yet
